update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.78 - URA Duel Handler and Spark Trait Reroll
Added ----- - URA Duel: bot now detects Happy Meek's stat contest screen during URA Finale, picks the trainee's highest stat among Speed/Power/Wits, navigates the carousel to that option, and confirms. - Spark Trait Reroll: after inheritance spark selection, the bot detects the Traits reroll screen and rerolls all spark traits up to a configurable limit (sparkTraitMaxRerolls), stopping early when the star count meets the threshold (sparkTraitMinStars), then clicks Decide. Active for all scenarios.
